<subject>Department Meeting on 9 May</subject>
<body>
We will be having a department meeting on 9 May at 4 PM. We will be discussing loan portfolio updates, risk assessment changes, and team realignments. Sandwiches will be provided. I would like to hold these sessions monthly to keep pace with market shifts and ensure everyone is informed about operational changes. If you cannot attend or have specific topics to raise, or a preference for sandwiches, please let me know as soon as possible.

Thanks,  
Brandon
</body>
